info.title: RFM Loyalty Engine API
info.description: Multi-tenant, closed-loop, B2B2C loyalty engine. Four surfaces: Superadmin (/v1/admin), Brand Admin (/v1/manage), Customer (/v1/customer), Terminal (/v1/terminal).

brandId.description: Only for the legacy per-brand sign-in. The customer app signs in to the wallet, which spans brands, and sends no brandId.

definition.description: { condition?, actions[] } per the rules engine

discountMinor.description: What the voucher takes off the bill, in minor units (2000 = AED 20.00). Required for kind=voucher/discount — without it the till applies zero.
Bill discount in minor units (2000 = AED 20.00).

threshold.description: Lifetime points to reach this tier

target.description: Target (lifetime points / visits / spend depending on kind)

repeatable.description: Stamp card: refills after each completion

rewardItemId.description: Reward catalogue item issued as a voucher on completion

repeatable.description: Stamp card: refills after each completion

rewardItemId.description: Reward catalogue item issued on completion

birthdate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty string clears it

memberToken.description: Identifies the member so rewards applied to this sale are recorded on the receipt.

bonuses.description: Campaigns behind the earn, echoed back from the transaction response: [{ name, factor?, points? }]. Printed and emailed so a happy hour is visible on the receipt rather than being a bigger number with no explanation.

code.description: Voucher code shown by the customer

memberToken.description: Verify the voucher belongs to this member

settings.description: Platform-wide defaults (currency, governance, expiry, support email).

membershipId.description: The customer membership receiving the voucher

reason.description: Why it was issued (recorded in the audit log)

rateValueMinor.description: …are worth this much in minor currency units

maxPercentOfBillBps.description: Max share of the bill payable in points (basis points, 10000 = 100%)

roundToMinor.description: Discount rounding step in minor units (e.g. 25 fils)

presetsPoints.description: Quick-pick point amounts shown at the POS

baseUrl.description: Terminal API base URL embedded in the provisioning QR payload

amountMinor.description: Credit amount in minor units (e.g. fils)

costPerPointMinor.description: Drawdown cost per redeemed point (minor units)

access.description: Map of moduleKey → enabled (false = hidden for the brand)

versionCode.description: Monotonic; the device compares it against its own build.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the APK.

notes.description: What changed — shown on the till's update prompt.

mandatory.description: Cannot be dismissed at the till.

published.description: Publishing offers the build to every till in the estate.

pattern.description: Pattern ('#' → random char) or a prefix

valueMinor.description: Fixed discount (minor units) or bonus points

definition.description: { match: all|any, rules: [{ field, op, value }] }

event.description: Trigger key, e.g. earn | redeem | tier_up | points_expiring

note.description: Optional note for the platform team.

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; null clears it.

txnAlertsOptOut.description: Stop the WhatsApp message sent after each transaction. Sign-in codes are unaffected.

email.description: Email address, or null to clear.

branchId.description: Branch id, or null to clear.
